description: The IoT Software Analyst role, based on the modules you 've posted, involves designing, developing, testing, and maintaining end-to-end IoT solutions. Key activities include working with connectivity protocols, developing and integrating software at device, platform, and cloud levels, ensuring system reliability, and testing for functionality and performance. The role also emphasizes automation (CI/CD pipelines), configuration management, quality assurance through various testing methods (functional, non-functional, end-to-end), and proper documentation. Skills required include programming.
awardingBodyName: Nasscom  National Association of Software and Service Companies
